name: turing_springs
theme: a geothermal terrace country read as one pattern at every scale — aurora light falling into steam over rainbow hot-spring shelves, down through a pool's orange rim into the mat's stripes and spots, into the thread ranks inside one stripe, whose banding is reread as a gas giant's latitude lanes

registers.name: terrace_field
registers.palette: fire orange and rust on charcoal, deep teal water
registers.scene: a wide spread of stepped hot-spring terraces seen from high in the air, dozens of round mineral pools set into pale shelves, every pool ringed in bands of fire orange and rust over charcoal basalt, deep teal water at the middle of each one, thin white steam lying across the shelves, dark lava ground between the terrace groups, empty, no one present
registers.target: a round teal pool ringed in orange

registers.name: pool_eye
registers.palette: deep teal water inside orange and rust rims
registers.scene: one hot-spring pool seen from its stone rim, clear teal water at the middle over a pale sinter floor, broad bands of orange and rust crust wrapped around the shallow edge, wet mineral ledges stepping down into the water, dark basalt gravel past the rim, empty, no one present
registers.target: a broad band of orange crust

registers.name: mat_rim
registers.palette: ember orange and rust with pale channels
registers.scene: the crusted surface of an orange microbial mat along a pool's edge, broken into winding stripes and round spots, ember and rust bands separated by narrow pale channels, shallow teal water caught in the low channels between the ridges, wet glistening crust across the whole spread

registers.name: thread_ranks
registers.palette: pale gold threads on dark teal
registers.scene: a forest of fine glassy threads standing inside one stripe of the mat, pale gold strands in long parallel ranks, dark teal water lanes running between the ranks, round gas beads caught among the strands, the whole spread banded light and dark

registers.name: gas_giant
registers.palette: ember orange and ash grey with a teal-green pole glow
registers.scene: a banded gas giant hanging in deep space, broad latitude bands of ember orange and ash grey wrapped in long parallel lanes around the sphere, fine curled ripples along every band boundary, a teal-green glow gathered at the pole, a scatter of stars behind it
registers.target: a standing sheet of teal-green light

registers.name: aurora_curtains
registers.palette: teal-green light over ash grey and ember cloud bands
registers.scene: towering aurora curtains standing over a dark banded cloud deck, seen from high above the planet's night side, long ranks of green and teal light with rippled lower edges, pale glowing fog gathered where the light meets the cloud tops, the deck below banded in ember orange and ash grey, a wide field of stars overhead
registers.loop_target: towering aurora curtains of green and teal light over a dark banded cloud deck, seen from high above the planet's night side

registers.name: steam_clouds
registers.palette: white steam on charcoal and rust
registers.scene: a bank of white steam clouds low over dark volcanic country, ragged columns standing up from the ground beneath a flat pale layer, wide breaks in the cover where orange-rimmed ground shows through, ash-grey slopes running out to a far horizon

music_theme: patient geothermal calm, warm low drone under a bright mineral shimmer, one long swell landing on the thread-ranks to gas-giant seam and a soft fall back through the steam
